en-US:
OpenCCman 2.0 · Build 53
Requires iOS 15 / macOS 12. Built with Xcode 27 and RevenueCat 5.78.0.
• macOS 13+: Settings adds Launch at login. Test enabling/disabling, returning after changes in System Settings, and signing in again. Restore your original setting afterwards. This entry must be hidden on macOS 12.
• Check Pro access, Customer Center, purchases and restoration. Record success, cancellation, offline and error states. Real purchase and restoration acceptance remains outstanding.
• Recheck long-text conversion, cancellation, TXT import/export, both layouts, multiple windows and scroll position. The single-file limit remains 10 MiB.
Include device, OS, reproduction steps and screenshots. Do not send sensitive source text.
